headline: Self-hosted widget tracker for small teams

verdict.why: Stateful job queue with real partial-failure gaps.

best_fits.why: Queue and store bugs span layers.

blocks.title: What it is
blocks.what: A widget tracker with a job queue.

blocks.summary: API server, job queue and a Postgres store.
A request enqueues a job that writes the store.

blocks.title: Job queue retries lose state 1
blocks.ambition: Job state lives in the queue, the database and the API cache, which disagree after a retry, so failed jobs show as running.
blocks.why_not_done: Touches every job type; the maintainers lack time to test partial failures.

evidence.fact: Retry re-enqueues without clearing the lease.
Status is written before the transaction commits.

where_models_fail: The lease in src/jobs/queue.ts outlives a worker crash, so the retry counter alone never frees the job.

bounded_task.shape: Lease release and status writes in src/jobs/queue.ts when a worker dies mid-job; the job stays leased and shows running.
bounded_task.check_in_session: test/store.test.ts with a worker killed mid-job; the leased row before and after.

one_shot.why: The lease is released three calls away in the store.
